fullContentHtml:
Short Information : has released the CBTST Exam Date for the Non Technical Popular Categories NTPC Graduate Level posts. RRB has invited huge number of vacancies for NTPC Graduate Level post recruitment during the 16 March 2026 to 27 March 2026. There were 5,810 posts were called for the hiring of RRB NTPC Graduate Level in various trades. The CBTST examination is going to be conducted in September 2026. Candidates who qualified for CBT II examination can check their RRB NTPC CEN 06/2025 Graduate Level CBTST Exam Date 2026 from the link given below.

Railway Recruitment Board (RRB)

RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-II Result 2026

RRB NTPC Graduate Level CEN 06/2025

Important Dates 

  • Application Start Date : 21 October 2025
  • Last Date : 27 November 2025 (Extended)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 November 2025
  • Correction / Modified Form : 30 November 2025 to 09 December 2025
  • Application Status : 20 January 2026
  • Exam Date CBT-I : 16-27 March 2026
  • Exam City Details : 10 Days Before Exam
  • Admit Card : 12 March 2026
  • Answer Key Available : 06 April 2026 
  • CBT-I Result : 11 June 2026
  • CBAT/ CBTST Exam Date : 30 September 2026
  • DV Date : December 2026
  • CBT-II Exam Date : 10 July 2026
  • CBT-II Exam City Details : 30 June 2026
  • CBT-II Admit Card : 06 July 2026
  • CBT-II Answer Key : 15 July 2026
  • CBT-II Result : 27 August 2026
  • CBTST Exam Date : September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

RRB NTPC Graduate Level Recruitment 2025 : Educational Qualification

  • Candidates having Graduation degree in any Stream from any recognized university / college will be considered for this post.
  • Typing proficiency in English / Hindi on Computer is essential.
  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.

RRB NTPC Graduate Level Online Form 2025 : Mode of Selection

  • CBT Written Exam
  • Typing Test (If Applicable)
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination

How To Download RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBTST Exam Date 2026

  • Candidates must go to the Important Links section below
  • Then the candidates must click on the CBTST exam date link.                  
  • After clicking on the link, the candidates will be redirected to a new page.
  • In this page, candidates have to enter the following details:
  • Registration no.
  • Login ID
  • Birth Date/Password
  • Captcha Code
  • Then the candidates have to  submit the details by clicking on the Login button.
  • After successful login, candidates will be able to download the CBTST exam date.
  • Alternatively, the candidates can download the CBTST exam date from the official website of RRB also.

Important Question

Q. Has the RRB NTPC CEN 06/2025 Graduate Level CBTST Exam Date 2026 been released?
Answer. Yes the RRB NTPC CEN 06/2025 Graduate Level CBTST Exam Date 2026 has been released.

Q. When was the RRB NTPC CEN 06/2025 Graduate Level CBTST Exam Date 2026 officially announced?
Answer. The RRB NTPC CEN 06/2025 Graduate Level CBTST Exam Date 2026 has issued on 27 August 2026 by RRB.

Q. When will the RRB NTPC CEN 06/2025 Graduate Level exam be held?
Answer. The RRB NTPC CEN 06/2025 Graduate Level CBTST examination will be conducted on 24 September 2026.

Q. Where can I check the RRB NTPC CEN 06/2025 Graduate Level CBTST Exam Date 2026?
Answer. You can check it on the official RRB website: rrb.indianrailways.gov.in

Q. What details are required to download the admit card?
Answer. Candidates need their Registration Number / Roll Number and Password / Captcha to download the admit card and exam city details.

Q. What is RRB Official Website?
Answer. The Official Website of RRB is https://rrb.indianrailways.gov.in/
